meta.title: 一个重要的布光理论 亮度=1/n²

scenes.title_cn: 反平方率：我们很直观地认为光走了一倍…
scenes.title_en: The inverse-square law: intuitively we thi…
scenes.context: 光衰减是反平方率，不是线性的。
sentences: 我们很直观地认为光走了一倍的距离，强度应当减弱一半，但是光的传播衰减倍率不是线性的。
Intuitively we think double distance halves light, but attenuation isn't linear.
not linear（非线性）
光衰减的公式是个反平方率，亮度等于n的平方分之一。
Light attenuation follows the inverse-square law: brightness = 1/n².
inverse-square law（反平方率）
距离增加一倍，光的亮度为原有的四分之一；增加两倍为原有的九分之一。
Double distance: a quarter brightness; triple: a ninth.
quarter and ninth（四分之一九分之一）
scenes.speak: Intuitively we think double distance halves light, but attenuation isn't linear. Light attenuation follows the inverse-square law: brightness = 1/n². Double distance: a quarter brightness; triple: a ninth.

scenes.title_cn: 对曝光的影响：这个对于我们曝光有什么…
scenes.title_en: Effect on exposure: what does this mean fo…
scenes.context: 光源太近导致人物间曝光差。
sentences: 一盏灯打两个人物，一个人物面部曝光刚刚好，但另一个人物面部却曝光不足。
One lamp, two people—one face perfect, the other underexposed.
uneven exposure（曝光不均）
问题处在光源离演员们太近了，两个人物之间光衰减得太急促。
The source is too close, so light falls off too sharply between them.
too close（太近）
越急促的衰减也意味着明暗反差越大。
Sharper falloff means bigger light-dark contrast.
bigger contrast（反差更大）
scenes.speak: One lamp, two people—one face perfect, the other underexposed. The source is too close, so light falls off too sharply between them. Sharper falloff means bigger light-dark contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 口播与背景分离：再举个应用场景，我们…
scenes.context: 光源靠近人物实现背景分离。
sentences: 光源离人物越近，那么背景的亮度衰减也越大。
The closer the source, the more the background falls off.
close = more falloff（越近越衰减）
如果我们把光源拉远，人物和背景的亮度差就会逐渐缩小。
Pull the source away and the brightness gap narrows.
farther = smaller gap（拉远缩小差）
反平方率不完全适用于所有情况，特定的条件下它是会失效的。
The inverse-square law doesn't fully apply everywhere—it can fail.
it can fail（会失效）
scenes.speak: The closer the source, the more the background falls off. Pull the source away and the brightness gap narrows. The inverse-square law doesn't fully apply everywhere—it can fail.

practice: A near lamp lights one spot; the sun lights everyone.
A source too close makes faces fall off unevenly.
Move the source close to separate the background.
The inverse-square law fails under specific conditions.
pitfalls: Close sources make background falloff stronger.
Blame the actors for uneven exposure.
A source too close causes the light gap between faces.
Pull the source away to separate the background.
Bring it closer to isolate the background.
shifts: 用 inverse-square law（反平方率）、geometric（几何式）、not linear（非线性）
用 uneven exposure（曝光不均）、sharp falloff（急促衰减）、light-dark contrast（明暗反差）
用 background separation（背景分离）、subject-background gap（人物背景差）、the law can fail（定律会失效）
